entities.name: Zombie
entities.description: Animated corpses, usually with little connection to the soul of the deceased, found on many planes.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: An Alaran shard where beings become undead aether-liches by replacing flesh with etherium.

entities.name: Aether-liches
entities.description: Undead abominations of Esper who replaced most or all of their flesh with etherium and house their soul in an Immortal Coil.

entities.name: Scullers
entities.description: Undead boatmen of Esper's tidecaves who ferry travelers for unusual payments.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: An Alaran shard where necromancers create zombies to serve them or prolong their lives.

entities.name: Leogin
entities.description: A lich under the sea near Kederekt, the undead form of an archmage who drowned before Vithia fell, who commands putrefied sea beasts.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A plane saturated in dark energies that make every living creature rise as undead after death.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: The dark energy of Amonkhet that causes every living creature to rise again as undead, the Accursed, until they become skeletal.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: The central city of Amonkhet, protected by a shield, where the dead are embalmed as mummies.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon planeswalker who crafted Amonkhet to create an army of Eternals, the Dreadhorde.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Zombies of Amonkhet embalmed in lazotep after passing the trials, forming Bolas's elite undead army.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Nicol Bolas's lethal undead army of Eternals, which later arrived on Ravnica.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who slays those who fail the trials.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who was slain and whose corpse was embalmed by mummies, later returning as a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: A god of Amonkhet who became a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Temmet
entities.description: The last vizier to control the mummies of Naktamun.

entities.name: Hashaton
entities.description: An Eternal who chose to keep serving the Scarab God.

entities.name: The Chitin Court
entities.description: The three corrupted gods of Amonkhet, said to be undead and coated in lazotep.

entities.name: The Scarab God
entities.description: A surviving member of the Chitin Court served by the Eternal Hashaton.

entities.name: Monarchs of the Broken Lands
entities.description: Undead kings, queens and emperors from early epochs who languished in sealed tombs and now reign over the restless dead.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The battle on Ravnica in which the Dreadhorde and the abominable gods of Amonkhet attacked.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-dominated plane whose invasion of Amonkhet is described.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane partially infested with zombies, ghouls and skaabs.

entities.name: Skaabs
entities.description: Innistradi zombies stitched together from corpses by mad mages, notoriously flammable.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane whose Viking zombies are the draugr of the realm of Karfell.

entities.name: Draugr
entities.description: An ancient race of undead lords and their subjects in Karfell, driven by lust for wealth and power.

entities.name: King Narfi
entities.description: The king of Karfell who betrayed his people and led the god of death to turn the nobles and subjects into undead.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane where zombies are known as the nim.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: People of Mirrodin zombified by necrogen from the Mephidross Swamp.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Mirrodin's creator whose defeat briefly rendered the nim inert.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: A Mirrodin tribe that killed many inert nim and was then slaughtered in the Nim Onslaught.

entities.name: Nim Onslaught
entities.description: The slaughter of the Moriok by the reawakened nim after Memnarch's defeat.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where the Golgari Swarm and the Cult of Rakdos employ zombies.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses ritual magic to make zombies, many imbued with plants, insects or fungi.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose mindless zombies have bodies altered with spikes and metal teeth.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: A Golgari guildmaster who was himself a zombie with full faculties.

entities.name: Svogthir
entities.description: A Golgari parun who was himself a zombie.

entities.name: The Erstwhile
entities.description: Once an important soldier faction of Ravnica, laid to rest in Umerilek and returned as Zombie Attendants of Vraska.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker served by the returned Erstwhile as Zombie Attendants.

entities.name: Phyrexian tingler
entities.description: A Phyrexian centipede-like device that crawls into a victim's mouth, rips out the spinal cord and controls the corpse.

entities.name: Etched Host
entities.description: A Host of New Phyrexia most likely to use decaying flesh hosts for phyresis.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: A Tarkir clan proficient in necromancy whose returned dead are the sibsig.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: Zombies of the Sultai Brood, once mistreated and now honored with consent-based raising.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A merciless dragon whose brood reigned over the Sultai.

entities.name: Noston
entities.description: Faceless undead of Theros who escaped the Underworld by losing their identity and memories.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god who governs Theros's Underworld.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: The organization responsible for the zombies that were disturbingly common on Otaria.

entities.name: Revenants
entities.description: The zombies raised by the Cabal in Modern Times.

entities.name: Nulls
entities.description: Faceless Zendikari zombies, stronger and faster than typical, made when a vampire fully drains a creature without destroying the husk.

events.summary: King Narfi betrays his people and leads the god of death to transform Karfell's nobles and subjects into undead draugr.
events.quote: King Narfi betrayed his people and led the god of death to transform all Karfell's nobles and their subjects into undead.

events.summary: After Memnarch's defeat the nim are briefly inert and many are killed by the Moriok.
events.quote: the Nim were briefly rendered inert, and many were killed by the Moriok

events.summary: The reawakened nim slaughter the Moriok in the Nim Onslaught.
events.quote: they began slaughtering Moriok in an event later known as the Nim Onslaught or Nim Massacre.

events.summary: As Oketra is slain, mummies begin to embalm her corpse; she later returns as part of the Dreadhorde in War of the Spark.
events.quote: As Oketra was slain, mummies began to embalm her corpse.

events.summary: On their arrival on Ravnica the Eternals become known as Bolas's Dreadhorde.
events.quote: the Eternals from Amonkhet became known as Bolas 's Dreadhorde .

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian invasion of Amonkhet the necropolis serves as recruiting ground for the invaders.
events.quote: the Necropolis served as prime recruiting grounds for the invaders

events.summary: The surviving Chitin Court gods side with the Monarchs of the Broken Lands, while the Eternal Hashaton keeps serving the Scarab God.
events.quote: at least the Eternal Hashaton chose to continue serving the Scarab God.

events.summary: With the fall of Naktamun, the masterless mummies try to continue their directives.
events.quote: With the fall of Naktamun and the embalming rituals, the masterless mummies attempted to continue their directives.

relations.note: The Dreadhorde is Bolas's lethal undead fighting force.
relations.quote: Bolas 's lethal undead fighting force, the Dreadhorde
the Eternals from Amonkhet became known as Bolas 's Dreadhorde .

relations.note: Jarls attend council meetings with King Narfi.
relations.quote: draugr jarls stir only every few months to attend council meetings with King Narfi

relations.note: The Erstwhile returned as her Zombie Attendants.
relations.quote: They returned as Zombie Attendants of Vraska .

relations.note: Placed in the Golgari zombie section as a soldier faction of Ravnica.
relations.quote: was once an important soldier faction in Ravnica

relations.note: He continued serving the Scarab God.
relations.quote: at least the Eternal Hashaton chose to continue serving the Scarab God.

relations.note: Governs the Underworld the Returned escaped.
relations.quote: undead that escaped the plane's Underworld , governed by the god Erebos
